added.title: Senior Manager - Machine Learning Engineering
added.description:
Full-time
Employee Type: Regular
Region: AMS - North America and Canada
Work Persona: Flexible

Company Description

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.

Join us to put AI to work for people.

Job Description

What you get to do in this role

We are looking for a Senior Manager of Machine Learning Engineering to lead a team building the next generation of AI Search and Retrieval capabilities that power intelligent experiences across the ServiceNow platform including Conversational and Agentic experiences.

You will lead engineers and machine learning practitioners responsible for designing and delivering highly scalable search, retrieval, ranking, recommendation, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems that enable users to discover information, generate insights, and accomplish work more effectively.

This leader will collaborate closely with Product Management, Applied AI, Platform Engineering, UX, and Quality Engineering to define strategy, execute roadmap commitments, and deliver AI-powered experiences that serve millions of users globally.

You will play a critical role in advancing the technologies powering ServiceNow AI Search, Knowledge Retrieval, and GenAI experiences, while building a high-performing engineering culture focused on innovation, quality, and business impact.

Responsibilities

Lead and grow a team of software engineers and machine learning engineers building large-scale AI Search and retrieval systems.
Drive the strategy, architecture, and execution for Search, Ranking, Relevance, Personalization, and RAG capabilities.
Partner with Product Managers and architects to define and deliver innovative AI-powered experiences.
Build scalable retrieval pipelines leveraging vector search, semantic search, ranking models, and large language models.
Improve relevance, precision, recall, and overall search quality across structured and unstructured enterprise content.
Establish architectural patterns for highly available, resilient, and performant distributed systems.
Lead the development and production deployment of machine learning models and retrieval services at enterprise scale.
Drive operational excellence, reliability, observability, and performance optimization across the platform.
Mentor engineering leaders and individual contributors while fostering a culture of collaboration, innovation, and technical excellence.
Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to evaluate emerging AI technologies and accelerate their adoption into customer-facing products.
Balance short-term delivery goals with long-term technical investments and platform evolution.

Qualifications

To be successful in this role you have:

12+ years of software engineering experience with a Bachelor's degree, or 10+ years with a Master's degree, or equivalent experience.
3+ years of engineering management experience leading high-performing technical teams.
Strong expertise in Java or Python and large-scale distributed systems.
Hands-on experience with Search technologies such as Lucene, Elasticsearch, Solr, OpenSearch, Algolia, Coveo, Glean, or similar platforms.
Experience building and operating large-scale retrieval, ranking, recommendation, or search systems.
Experience with modern AI/ML technologies, including LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, and RAG architectures.
Strong understanding of information retrieval, search relevance, ranking algorithms, and semantic search.
Experience deploying and operating machine learning models in production environments.
Knowledge of cloud-native architectures, microservices, observability, and performance optimization.
Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to influence across engineering and product organizations.
Proven track record of delivering innovative products from concept through production at enterprise scale.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience building enterprise search, knowledge retrieval, or GenAI products.
Experience with personalization, recommendation systems, or relevance optimization.
Experience working with vector search technologies and embedding frameworks.
Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams.
Experience integrating AI capabilities into customer-facing SaaS products.

Why this role is exciting

Own a critical part of ServiceNow's AI platform strategy.
Influence how millions of users discover knowledge and interact with AI-powered experiences.
Lead a team at the intersection of Search, Machine Learning, and Agentic platform.
Partner with world-class engineers, researchers, and product leaders.
Help shape the future of AI-driven enterprise productivity.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100
, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Additional Information

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements. 

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

added.description:
Job Title
: Head of Platform Technologies, MSAT Recombinant Mammalian Drug Substance CoE

Location: Framingham, MA

About The Job

Sanofi Global MSAT (Manufacturing Sciences, Analytics, and Technology) acts as a crucial link between our R&D and Manufacturing facilities, playing a vital role in securing the present portfolio and delivering future launches of high-quality and innovative drugs and vaccines. By driving its own transformation, Global MSAT fulfils an important function by providing day-to-day Manufacturing Support, focusing on technical and process aspects, effective Life Cycle Management, process robustness enhancement, and yield improvement to optimize performance.

Join our global network and contribute to the launch of 3 to 5 new products annually across various modalities, enabling us to reach and serve more patients and communities. Collaborate with a team of talented and passionate international experts, scientists, and project leaders who are dedicated to inventing, designing, and implementing cutting-edge industrial chemical and biological processes, analytical methods, and process modelling, all in support of Sanofis best-in-class ambition.

The Head of Platform Technologies will lead a dynamic team of Subject Matter Experts within the MSAT Recombinant Mammalian Center of Excellence (CoE), located at Sanofis Massachusetts Framingham Bio-Campus. This team is responsible for establishing stateoftheart innovation laboratory infrastructures and enabling nextgeneration platform technologies, including perfusion cell culture and continuous purification processes.

This senior leadership role will support implementation strategies for commercial programs by collaborating closely with R&D, Manufacturing, and external partners. The team will also spearhead global MSAT innovation initiatives across platforms in partnership with other MSAT groups, while representing MSATs scientific leadership and excellence in both internal and external forums.

We deliver 4.3 billion healthcare solutions to people every year, thanks to the flawless planning and meticulous eye for detail of our Manufacturing & Supply teams. With your talent and ambition, we can do even more to protect people from infectious diseases and bring hope to patients and their families.

About Sanofi

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve lives.

Hybrid Schedule - 3 days per week onsite- required. *

Main Responsibilities

The Head of Platform Technologies will lead a Subject Matter Experts (SME) team to deliver the following core objectives:

Lead the evaluation of Sanofis nextgeneration platform technologies including perfusion cell culture, continuous purification, advanced Process Analytical Technology (PAT), smart manufacturing, and emerging novel process chemistries. Develop the MSAT position on development data package requirements, atscale operational readiness, transferability, labscale model expectations, and MSAT training and expertise needs. Ensure alignment of platformtechnology initiatives with broader organizational objectives such as 2ndgeneration program development, process robustness, and yield improvement.
Establish and maintain cuttingedge innovation laboratory infrastructures within the COE. Partner with upstream, downstream, and analytical teams to advance lab digitization and automation. Build additional laboratory and pilotscale capabilities that embody Sanofis smartlab future concept.
Build and maintain strategic relationships with external partners and vendors. Oversee multiple collaboration projects with external suppliers to support manufacturing investigations, process development, raw material characterization, novel equipment and capability assessment, and codevelopment of new technologies. Coordinate these activities seamlessly with MSAT, R&D, and Global Procurement functions.
Drive global MSAT innovation initiatives in collaboration with other technology platforms (Vaccines, Drug Product, Microbial). Promote knowledge sharing and bestpractice adoption across teams. Represent MSATs scientific excellence in internal forums (smart factory, digital transformation, eco-design, efficiency) and external forums (Bio-Industry forums, biomanufacturing conferences). Strengthening Sanofis reputation as a leader in biopharmaceutical manufacturing innovation.
Contribute to CoE activities by providing SME input and technical guidance for laboratory work, commercial program life cycle management, and technology transfers. Collaborate effectively with both local and network cross-function teams (e.g. lab, manufacturing, quality, regulatory, business etc.) as needed.
Mentor and develop team members, fostering their professional growth and technical expertise, while ensuring a diverse technical background and comprehensive skillset coverage for drug substance processes as part of CoE strategic workforce planning.

About You

Basic Qualifications

PhD degree in Chemical/Biological/ Sciences/Engineering - preferred. Master's degree - required.
10+ years of experience related to biopharmaceutical industry - required.
5+ years of hands-on experience in biologics drug substance process development, technology development or manufacturing support - required.
Demonstrated experience leading bioprocess and biomanufacturing innovation initiatives from concept through implementation. Deep knowledge of bioprocess development and operations (e.g., upstream, downstream, drugsubstance stability). Familiarity with laboratory, pilotscale, and largescale manufacturing operations.
Process knowledge across multiple modalities (e.g. mAbs, small protein and peptide, bioconjugates, nucleotides, Gene/cell therapy, organic chemistry etc.)
Prior experience of managing suppliers, contractor manufacturing or contract research partners
Excellent scientific background and effective communication skills. Demonstrated ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects and consistently meet deadlines. Highly motivated individual, with the ability to work independently as well as within cross-functional and cross-site teams
Oral and written fluency in English

Why choose us?

Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether its through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention andwellness programs and at least 14 weeks gender-neutral parental leave.
Shape the future of medicine and vaccine delivery with cutting-edge technology, ensuring seamless launches and a resilient global supply.
Power industry-leading performance by leveraging digital, data, and AI-driven innovation at speed and scale
Transform lives worldwide by delivering life-changing treatments anywhere, anytime.

Sanofi Inc. and its U.S. affiliates are Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employers committed to a culturally diverse workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race; color; creed; religion; national origin; age; ancestry; nationality; marital, domestic partnership or civil union status; sex, gender, gender identity or expression; affectional or sexual orientation; disability; veteran or military status or liability for military status; domestic violence victim status; atypical cellular or blood trait; genetic information (including the refusal to submit to genetic testing) or any other characteristic protected by law.

added.title: Director, Engineering, Applied AI
added.description:
Overview

Impact the Moment

At McGraw Hill, our mission is to unlock the full potential of every learner. This role puts you at the center of that mission, applying cutting-edge AI to products used by millions of students and educators.

We're looking for a Director, AI Enablement
to build and lead the team responsible for making our company AI native. This is a senior leadership role with singular ownership of AI enablement across the organization, spanning three pillars: business workflow enablement, data enablement, and developer enablement. You will report to the VP of Applied AI Engineering and will be accountable for adoption, best practices, governance, cost, and ROI across every business and technology AI transformation we undertake.

This role is not about running a single project or a single pillar. It's about building the function, the team, and the operating model that turns AI from a set of scattered tools into a core capability that every part of the business, and every engineering team, relies on. You will set the strategy across all three pillars, lead the group and personally represent AI enablement to executive leadership, while staying close enough to the work to know where it's succeeding and where it's stalling.

We are looking for a hands on practitioner on enterprise GenAI tools like M365 Copilot, Claude and coding assistants like Github Copilot, Claude Code; someone who can operate at both altitudes: deep in the technology and equally comfortable in executive presence.

This is a remote position open to applicants authorized to work for any employer within the United States.

What You'll Do:

Team & Function Leadership

Build, lead, and grow the AI Enablement team across all three pillars: business workflow enablement, data enablement, and developer enablement.
Set the strategy, priorities, and operating model for how the company adopts and scales AI across business workflows, data initiatives, and software development alike.
Partner closely with the team's Solution Architect, who owns the technical architecture, patterns, and standards across all three pillars, to turn strategy into execution.
Hire, coach, and develop a team that can move fast, work hands-on, and partner credibly with both technical and business stakeholders.
Represent AI enablement to executive leadership, translating technical progress into business impact and securing the resources the function needs.

Adoption, Governance & Best Practices

Own the company's overall approach to AI adoption across business, data, and developer audiences alike, defining what good looks like and building the playbooks, standards, and training that get teams there.
Establish governance for how AI tools are evaluated, approved, and used, balancing speed of adoption with security, compliance, and risk.
Make sure best practices for efficient, cost-conscious use of enterprise AI tools, including coding assistants and token optimization, are defined and adopted across all three pillars.
Build the mechanisms that keep AI fluency growing over time: training programs, communities of practice, and enablement resources for business users, data practitioners, and developers alike.

Cost, ROI & Business Impact

Own the cost model and help set the budget for AI tools and enablement programs, and make disciplined decisions about where to invest across all three pillars.
Define how AI ROI gets measured across the company, and build the reporting that shows leadership what is working and what isn't.
Prioritize the AI enablement portfolio based on business impact, balancing high-visibility initiatives with the unglamorous work that drives real adoption.
Continuously reassess priorities as tools, vendors, and business needs evolve, and be willing to change direction quickly when the data calls for it.

Who You Are:

A senior leader with a software engineering background who can engage credibly with engineers and executives alike, across business, data, and developer domains.
An expert-level user of AI tools yourself, not just a manager of people who use them. You should be someone others come to for advice on how to get the most out of these tools.
Experience leading a team, ideally one focused on technology adoption, enablement, platform strategy, or a similar cross-functional focus.
A track record of driving org-wide change: getting a large group of people to adopt new tools, processes, or ways of working.
Comfortable owning governance, cost, and ROI conversations, and able to speak fluently about risk and business value, not just technology.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with the judgment to know when to lead from the front and when to let your team run.
Prior experience participating in or leading an AI transformation initiative is highly preferred.

What Success Looks Like:

The company operates as a genuinely AI native organization, with AI fluency and adoption embedded across business, data, and developer teams alike.
The AI Enablement team is high-performing, well-regarded, and seen as a trusted partner rather than a gatekeeper across all three pillars.
Governance, cost, and ROI for AI initiatives are well understood and clearly reported, giving leadership confidence in how AI investment is managed.
AI enablement is recognized across the company as a durable, strategic function, not a temporary initiative.

Why work for us?

The work you do at McGraw Hill will be work that matters. We are collectively building experiences that will help shape the future of education. Play your part and experience a sense of fulfilment that will inspire you to even greater heights.

The pay range for this position is between $175,000 - $220,000 annually, however, base pay offered may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. An annual bonus plan may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of medical and/or other benefits, depending on the position offered. Click here to learn more about our benefit offerings.

McGraw Hill recruiters always use a “@mheducation.com” email address and/or from our Applicant Tracking System, iCIMS. Any variation of this email domain should be considered suspicious. Additionally, McGraw Hill recruiters and authorized representatives will never request sensitive information in email.

added.title: Head of AI Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform
added.description:
Job Title:
Head of AI- Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform

Location: Morristown, NJ, Cambridge, MA

About The Job

Sanofi's Digital Business Horizon 2030 is to deliver best-in-class and first-in-class science faster to patients. Project Orion is a mandatory and strategic migration from OneCRM (end-of-support end-2029) to a new Customer Engagement Management Platform (CEMP), covering 13,000 users across 45 countries. This is not a like-for-like replacement it is a leap forward to an AI-native, omnichannel customer engagement platform.

The Head of AI-Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform holds a pivotal role responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation of Sanofi's new Customer Engagement Management Platform, including the deployment of Concierge for Field as the single conversational entry point for all customer-facing teams, and the transition from the current Veeva OneCRM system to the ExCom selected CEMP platform.

This role is central to Sanofi's Go-to-Market transformation, enabling all field-based teams to engage customers in a seamless, AI-augmented, and data-driven way. There is a significant investment envelope behind over the period from 20272030, making this one of the most strategically significant digital programs at Sanofi.

Ready to push the limits of whats possible? Join Sanofi in one of our corporate functions and you canplay a vital part in the performance of our entire business while helping to make an impact on millionsaround the world

About Sanofi

Were an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving peoples lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system and innovative pipeline enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve peoples lives.

Main Responsibilities

The Head of AI-Driven Digital Customer Engagement Management Platform is accountable for the successful delivery of Project Orion including concierge for Field, the strategic migration and transformation of Sanofi's customer engagement platform ecosystem. She/He will lead a cross-functional program team, partner closely with the GBUs, Markets, GTMC, and ensure the platform enables Sanofi's vision of an AI-augmented, customer-centric engagement at scale.

Program Leadership & Implementation

Lead successfully the end-to-end implementation of Project Orion, Sanofi's strategic migration from OneCRM to the new Customer Engagement Management Platform (CEMP), covering up to 13,000 users across ~ 45 countries by 2030 while driving exceptional user feedback.
Own the full program delivery lifecycle: from final vendor negotiations with procurement, platform configuration, ecosystem integration, data migration, to phased global rollout across US, China, and all other markets.
Drive the execution plan with platform vendor and system integrator, end-to-end ecosystem pressure testing, inventory of all interdependencies, governance and staffing (internal and external), detailed wave-by-wave rollout plan, and KPIs of success.
Oversee the rollout roadmap with an US first mindset, China, and other markets as per company country prioritization to full scale before lifecycle end of the current VeevaSalesforce platform.
Ensure OneCRM continuity and manage the license extension with Veeva through end 2029 to minimize implementation risk.
Manage diligently the investment envelope over 20272030, ensuring rigorous financial governance, milestone tracking, and value realization.
Lead Product ownership on consent and customer access management as a strategic layer of the platform and process revamp to break with the past and enable a future AI ready consent and customer ID management

Concierge for Field Deployment

Lead the scaling of Concierge for Field as the single conversational entry point for all customer-facing teams (field reps, MSLs, KAMs, market access, etc.), replacing direct CRM login with an AI-native, voice/chat-first interface in line with the overall Concierge one front strategy across the enterprise.
Own the Concierge for Field product roadmap and skills backlog, prioritizing capabilities based on business impact and accessibility (time to value) in intimate coordination with the US and key markets: e.g. Pre-Call Planning, Call Reporting, Objection Handling, Territory Analytics, Morning Brief, Reimbursement & Access Guidance, and all the upcoming specific capabilities that are being identified.
Scale Concierge for Field from current beta version to full production first across the US and then across all global field users, including a federated China deployment via WeCom/Tencent ADP.
Govern the skill prioritization framework (Impact x Accessibility matrix) in collaboration with Business Owners and GTMC counterparts.
Actively connect with the respective commercial analytics teams to ensure that roadmaps are coordinated and address interdependencies, as wells a clear governance is maintained in coordination of agents with the Agent hub as well as other AI analytical or agent uses cases in commercial analytics and AI PL, as well as the central data COE, concierge team.
Ensure the "headless CRM" architecture is fully implemented: Concierge as the front-end, CEMP as the invisible compliant backend system of record

Platform Architecture & AI

Ensure Sanofi owns the intelligence layer of customer engagement: data, AI logic, and orchestration remain Sanofi-owned and vendor-agnostic, regardless of the CRM platform selected.
Oversee the build of Sanofi's AI and agentic layer (built on Elementum AI / AWS Bedrock for global, Tencent ADP for China), delivering differentiated AI capabilities including omnichannel orchestration, proactive agentic workflows, and NBA/NBI signals, etc.
Manage the data foundation dependencies (USDF, LUCI, MDF, OneCustomer/Reltio) as critical prerequisites for Wave 1 go-live.
Ensure the core CRM & CEMP capabilities are reflected through re-designed workflows / progressively automated or exposed natively through Concierge, reducing field admin time from ~30% to near-zero.

Stakeholder & Governance

Lead the Orion program governance together with the GTMC partners including SteerCo cadence, cross-functional workstream coordination (Digital key functions, GTMC, GBUs, markets, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Cybersecurity).
Ensure continued outside-in perspective with constant sanity checks on benchmarking and best in class experiences.
Mobilize and manage effectively the program team (internal and external resources), including PMO, change management, digital build, agent development, and advisory workstreams.
Partner hand in have with GTMC and digital markets for change management, field adoption, and go-to-market alignment across all waves.
Serve as the primary interface between Digital, GBUs, and executive governance (Digital xGBU Tower, ExCom) for all CEMP-related decisions.
Communicate pro-actively program status, anticipate risks, and value delivery to senior leadership, and the respective key stakeholders, users to build enterprise-wide awareness.

Responsible AI

Ensure appropriate management of AI-related risks throughout the CEMP and Concierge for Field system lifecycle by ensuring ongoing compliance to Sanofi's Responsible AI internal standards & legal requirements (RAISE)
Ensure the execution of AI Governance tasks and compliance with controls throughout the AI system lifecycle, including (non-exhaustive): Validation and post-deployment monitoring, meeting all applicable quality, regulatory (Data Privacy, GxP, SOX, Artificial Intelligence), and cybersecurity requirements. Maintaining adherence to these standards across all AI products deployed within the CEMP ecosystem

Ways of working

You will be a member of the Global Digital GBU Leadership Team.
You will foster close partnerships and collaboration between cross-functional teams (GBUs, Digital, GTMC, Market teams, Procurement, Finance, Compliance, Cybersecurity) and drive structured ways of working between teams to provide maximum value and efficiency to business teams.
You will work closely and constructively with other development teams, e.g., Accelerator, Cybersecurity, Architecture, Data, and Web teams, whether inside or outside the company.
You will work in close partnership with key markets with an US first to ensure digital solutions are grounded in market realities and deliver measurable impact.
You will empower your teams to set up lean but effective structures and efficient local governance.
You will build and develop a team that is accountable, uses complementary strengths and develop dedicated, strong, and diverse leaders and that can be a role model both technical skills as well as through its forward looking mindset.

About You

Technical skills:

10+ years of digital/technology experience with 5+ years in senior program or product leadership roles required
